Stock market news | Sensex drops 990 points as Nifty hovers 25,600

On 27 November 2026 the Sensex slipped roughly 990 points while the Nifty hovered around 25,600, marking a sharp decline for Dalal Street.

Analysts point to a weakening rupee, renewed inflation concerns and speculation over a US Fed rate hike as the main drivers, keeping investors cautious.
